description: This is a C# test class for functional testing of the Basket/Index page in an e-commerce web application. It uses HttpClient to perform HTTP requests simulating user interactions like adding and updating items in the basket, asserting the correctness of responses.

classes.name: IndexTest
classes.description: Functional test class for checking basket update scenarios including updating quantity and emptying basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo50Successfully
methods.description: Test method that adds an item to the basket and updates its quantity to 49, asserting success and total amount.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo0EmptyBasket
methods.description: Test method that adds an item to the basket and then sets its quantity to zero, asserting that the basket becomes empty.
